text:
## 15. REGULATORY INFORMATION  
**This Account is Protected by:**
- Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS): Up to £85,000 per customer
- Direct Debit Guarantee: Full refund if unauthorized
- FCA Complaints Handling: 8-week investigation  
**Regulator:**
- Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
- Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA)  
---

raw_entities.name: Financial Services Compensation Scheme Protection
raw_entities.description: Customer deposits are protected under the Financial Services Compensation Scheme up to a maximum of £85,000 per customer per institution. This protection applies to this account and provides compensation in the event of bank failure or insolvency.
context: Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS): Up to £85,000 per customer
This Account is Protected by: Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS)

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit Guarantee
raw_entities.description: The bank guarantees a full refund to the customer if any direct debit payment is made without proper authorization. This protection is a regulatory requirement under the Direct Debit scheme.
context: Direct Debit Guarantee: Full refund if unauthorized
This Account is Protected by: Direct Debit Guarantee

raw_entities.name: FCA Complaints Handling Procedure
raw_entities.description: The Financial Conduct Authority mandates that complaints must be investigated and resolved within 8 weeks. This provides customers with a defined timeframe for complaint resolution and escalation rights.
context: This Account is Protected by: FCA Complaints Handling

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority Regulation
raw_entities.description: The Financial Conduct Authority is the primary regulator overseeing this account and product. The FCA sets conduct standards, complaints procedures, and consumer protection requirements.

raw_entities.name: Prudential Regulation Authority Oversight
raw_entities.description: The Prudential Regulation Authority is a co-regulator responsible for prudential supervision, capital adequacy, and systemic risk management for this institution.
